name: waynestate/rollcall
description: WELD's fleet scanner: every app answers present with its PHP image, Laravel and auth-package versions and its PROCTOR result, checked against CREED's policy.

suggest.inertiajs/inertia-laravel: Only for the dashboard as one of an Inertia app's own Vue pages (ROLLCALL_DASHBOARD_INERTIA); the Blade and raw-PHP pages need nothing extra
suggest.laravel/framework: For the Laravel adapter: the dashboard page and the scheduled scan
suggest.symfony/mailer: Only to mail the opt-in owner digests (rollcall digest --send); printing them needs nothing extra
suggest.waynestate/advisor: ADVISOR's MCP server loads the Rollcall module (src/Advisor/RollcallModule.php) with its three read-only tools
suggest.waynestate/playbook: WSU's shared values (CAS, Entra, gateway); private, git.wayne.edu
suggest.waynestate/wayne-ui: WayneUI styles the dashboard page (Laravel or raw PHP). Install it, or link its stylesheet with ROLLCALL_WAYNEUI_CSS

scripts.a11y: echo "Front page accessibility gate (axe-core in Playwright, needs Docker): run scripts/a11y.sh on Linux and macOS or scripts/a11y.ps1 on Windows. It stays out of composer ci because CI has no browser."

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every CI check: manifest, tests, style, agent-ready files, docs site, front page generated regions, static analysis, audit
scripts-descriptions.creed-copy:check: Prove the generated CREED copy in src/Creed has not drifted (needs CREED_PATH set to a CREED checkout)
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
scripts-descriptions.site:versions: Regenerate the front page versions table and the quick-start printout's policy values in site/index.html and site/index.md from CREED's policy.json, then rewrite the agent-ready twins.
scripts-descriptions.site:versions-check: Fail when the front page versions table or the quick-start printout's policy values are stale. Judged as of the date stored in each start marker unless --date is passed.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the docs site from docs/ into site/docs/ (Squire's docs builder): render the pages, fill the generated command and environment reference, and stamp the current version.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when the built docs site is stale or the generated command or environment reference has drifted from the CLI or source.
scripts-descriptions.a11y: Print how to run the front page accessibility gate (scripts/a11y.sh, scripts/a11y.ps1); it needs a browser, so it is not part of composer ci
